genericProblem: A technical definition-field label can leak into a consumer read projection even when the projection is intended to contain only business display facts.
rootCauseClass: The new overview display projection reused the owner definition record property name instead of defining its consumer-facing business term.
finiteDenominator: two generated platform-admin extensionFields wire shapes
counterexamples: ExtensionDefinitionReadback.Field.label and extension-definition management contracts retain label because they are existing owner definition vocabulary, not a platform overview display projection.
No frontend source is in this correction scope; generated wire is the only consumer surface changed.

findings.evidence: Both new overview projections and their OpenAPI/generated wire shapes call the business display name label, while IA03 requires a returned definition business name followed by its value and prohibits technical facts.
